model.name: Eager child-count badges
model.description: Every collapsed trace-tree node shows a child-count BADGE reflecting its real childCount from server metadata BEFORE its children are loaded (structure+count eager, payload lazy). The CurrentSprint node and each Sprint node in the Sprints collection carry a badge = their true child count without expanding. Impl: RbTraceTree.computeBadges + renderCurrentSprintEagerLazy (nodeChildCount from server metadata), deployed v0.7.11.

discoverySource.note: S30 traceability improvement — eager child-count badges; minted by skill-expert (drive: req/planner rate-limited) to trace deployed v0.7.11 fix.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Every tree node child-count BADGE shows the correct count from when its PARENT loads (eager) - NOT 0-until-expand.
The count comes from the PARENT /children response metadata (childCount per child), not a per-node prefetch.
Lazy level-by-level: expanding a node loads its children WITH their own child-counts (next level badges correct); deeper content on further expand.
THE BUG: all sprint nodes showed badge=0 initially - must show the real task-count before expand.
Still PAYLOAD-LAZY: children CONTENT loads on expand; only COUNTS are eager (structure+count eager / payload lazy - R26 pattern).
